buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. New and Unused Products The LED Street Lights and LED Flood Lights supplied shall be brand new, unused and free from manufactur ing defects or damage. 2. Make and Model The bidder shall clearly indicate the Make and Model of the LED Street Lights and LED Flood Lights offered in the bid. The make and model accepted against the bid shall be supplied against the order and shall not be changed without the prior approval of the Cantonment Board. 3. Technical Datasheet / Brochure The bidder shall submit the manufacturer's technical datasheet/brochure of the offered products along wit h the bid, wherever applicable, indicating the make, model and relevant technical specifications of the offe red LED Street Lights and LED Flood Lights. 4. Warranty The LED Street Lights and LED Flood Lights supplied shall carry a comprehensive onsite warranty of three ( 03) years from the date of delivery and acceptance of the material by the Cantonment Board, Belagavi. Th e warranty shall cover manufacturing defects and failure of the products under normal operating condition s. The bidder shall submit the duly signed and stamped Warranty Undertaking, as per the format uploaded with the bid, along with the technical bid, confirming acceptance of all warranty obligations specified in the bid document. 5. Local After-Sales / Warranty Support The bidder shall have a GST-registered place of business or an authorized service/support establishment in Belagavi and shall submit documentary evidence thereof, along with complete address and contact details , with the bid. Adequate after-sales and warranty support shall be provided for the LED Street Lights and L ED Flood Lights throughout the warranty period. 6. Warranty Complaint Response The successful bidder shall attend to warranty complaints relating to the LED Street Lights and LED Flood L ights within 48 hours of reporting and shall complete the repair or replacement of the defective product wit hin five (05) days from the date of reporting the complaint. 7. Warranty Repair / Replacement

Any LED Street Light or LED Flood Light found defective or malfunctioning during the warranty period due t o manufacturing defect or failure under normal operating conditions shall be repaired or replaced by the s uccessful bidder at no additional cost to the Cantonment Board. 8. Collection of Defective Fittings In case any LED Street Light or LED Flood Light requires repair or replacement during the warranty period, the successful bidder shall arrange for collection of the defective item from the designated premises of Ca ntonment Board, Belagavi. The Cantonment Board shall not be required to transport or deliver the defectiv e item to the bidder/service centre. 9. Transportation / Packing / Courier Charges All expenses relating to collection, packing, transportation, courier, repair, replacement and re-delivery of defective LED Street Lights and LED Flood Lights during the warranty period shall be borne by the successf ul bidder. No such charges shall be payable by the Cantonment Board. 10. Inspection and Rejection The Cantonment Board or its authorized representative shall have the right to inspect the materials at the time of delivery. Any material found damaged, defective, short-supplied or not conforming to the ordered s pecifications may be rejected. Such rejected material shall be replaced by the successful bidder at no addi tional cost to the Cantonment Board. In the event that more than 05% of the supplied LED Street Lights an d LED Flood Lights are found defective during inspection, the Cantonment Board reserves the right to rejec t the entire consignment and take further action, including cancellation of the contract, as per the applicabl e terms and conditions. 11. Warranty Certificate The successful bidder shall provide the applicable warranty certificate/document for the supplied LED Stre et Lights and LED Flood Lights at the time of delivery, clearly indicating the warranty period and relevant p roduct details. 12. Participation through the Same IP Address If two or more bidders are found to have participated in the bid using the same IP address, the bids of all s uch bidders shall be disqualified from the bidding process. . 2.
